annotations.title: Score an email for phishing signals

description: Scores a suspicious email for phishing signals from its parsed fields. Provide any of: from_address, from_name, reply_to, return_path, subject, body_text, and links (up to 25). Returns a risk level and score with the specific flags behind them; links in the email are also checked against RelayShield's threat-intelligence corpus. A verdict of unknown means nothing conclusive was found; this tool never reports an email as safe.

body_text.description: Plain-text body, used for urgency/deadline/threat phrasing.

from_address.description: The claimed sender's address, e.g. alerts@phrase.com.

links.description: Links found in the body, up to 25.

reply_to.description: Reply-To address, if present and different from from_address.

return_path.description: Envelope sender, if available. Informational only.

name: check_email
title: Score an email for phishing signals
